Key features: pod/ear affected, blue-gray powdery/dense mold covering entire ear surface, some exposed orange kernels.

Top candidate: **Trichoderma_Ear_Rot** — described as "dark blue-green layers of conidia on and between kernels...symptoms typically occurring from base to middle of cob covering all kernels."

Let me verify with a reference image.

The reference confirms Trichoderma_Ear_Rot — dark green to gray-green mold on husk and ear surfaces. The test image shows the same disease at a more advanced stage with husks pulled back, revealing the characteristic blue-gray conidial mass covering the entire kernel surface. The coverage pattern (entire ear) and the dark blue-green/gray color match perfectly.
